languages.name: Tetum
languages.notes: Sec.13: Tetum + Portuguese official. Tetum L1 ~400k but L2 ~700k+ (Dili lingua franca — the inversion). Tetun Dili vs Tetun Terik (one code, note). Catholic-liturgy history.

ekguru.recommendation: none — world language; Lusophone case is pan-Portuguese (future batches).

languages.name: Portuguese
languages.notes: Sec.13 official (resistance-identity choice, 2002!). L1 tiny (few k) — official-by-history, L2 growing via CPLP teachers. 639-1 'pt' (SIL). Speakers {} honest.

ekguru.recommendation: Shared with Indonesia entry — one Indonesian course serves all (TL working-language note).

languages.name: Indonesian
languages.notes: Sec.13 WORKING language (alongside English) — occupation-legacy turned practical bridge (trade/older educated). Fading among youth (→Tetum/English/Portuguese) — note the shift.

languages.name: English
languages.notes: Sec.13 working language (UN-mission legacy + youth). Thin (low on 'widely') — kept: constitutional working status + ASEAN.

languages.name: Mambae
languages.notes: Biggest indigenous (~200k+, central mountains). No standard orthography (Tetun/Portuguese ad hoc). Coffee-highlands culture.

languages.name: Timorese Sign Language

languages.name: Vietnamese
languages.notes: Art.5: Vietnamese is national + official. 639-1 'vi' (SIL). Quốc-ngữ (Latin) script — missionary-made, now universal. 6 tones (north) — the pedagogy. Internal LF. Figures via ethnicity proxy (Kinh 85% — proxy gap noted).

languages.name: Tay (Tày)
languages.notes: Biggest minority ~1.8M (NE highlands). Tai language. Nôm-Tày script heritage (now Vietnamese-Latin ad hoc). Ethnicity-proxy figures (see vn-census note).

ekguru.recommendation: watch — Muong (closest Vietic kin); no action.

languages.name: Muong
languages.notes: ~1.4M (Hòa Bình). CLOSEST kin to Vietnamese (Vietic sisters — the linguistics hook: mutually unintelligible but visibly related). Vietnamese-Latin ad hoc script.

ekguru.recommendation: Shared with Cambodia entry — one Khmer pack serves both (Delta-dialect notes).

languages.name: Khmer
languages.notes: Mekong Delta (Khmer Krom) ~1.3M — the cross-border half of the Khmer people (record sensitively: Krom identity politics, one neutral line). Same code as KH.

ekguru.recommendation: watch — White Hmong; shared with LA entry.

languages.name: White Hmong
languages.notes: VN Hmong ~1M+ split White/Green — splits SOFT (see LA soft-split note, same caveat). Sapa-tourism visibility (trekking guides!) — the demand footnote. RPA script.

ekguru.recommendation: watch — Green Mong; shared with LA entry.

languages.name: Hmong Njua (Green Mong)
languages.notes: Sister entry to mww (same soft-split caveat). Flower-Hmong markets (Bắc Hà — the culture hook).

languages.name: Nung
languages.notes: ~1M+ (NE, Tay-adjacent). Tai language. SIL 'Nung (Viet Nam)' (vs other Nungs — the disambiguator).

languages.name: Jarai
languages.notes: Central Highlands ~400k+ + NORTH CAROLINA diaspora (refugee resettlement — the demand footnote!). Malayo-Polynesian (Austronesian enclave). Missionary Latin.

languages.name: Rade (Ê Đê)
languages.notes: ~350k+ (Đắk Lắk). SIL 'Rade'. Gong-ensemble culture (UNESCO heritage — the hook). Matrilineal longhouses. Missionary Latin.

languages.name: Bahnar
languages.notes: ~250k+ (Kon Tum). Austroasiatic (Bahnaric branch NAMESAKE — the linguistics hook). Rong-house culture. Missionary Latin.

ekguru.recommendation: watch — Eastern Cham (temple-tower hook); shared with KH cja.

languages.name: Eastern Cham
languages.notes: ~160k (Ninh Thuận/Bình Thuận). CHAM SCRIPT still used (temples/manuscripts — vs Western cja's Arabic script: the split note). Panduranga history (Mỹ Sơn towers — the hook).

ekguru.recommendation: watch — Tai Dam (Tai-Viet-script hook); no action.

languages.name: Tai Dam (Black Tai)
languages.notes: ~800k (Điện Biên/Sơn La). TAI VIET script (Tavt — own script, revived in schools!) — the hook. 'Black' = clothing (vs White Tai twh — sister entry).

ekguru.recommendation: watch — White Tai; shared with blt.

languages.name: Tai Dón (White Tai)
languages.notes: ~300k. SIL 'Tai Dón'. Sister to Tai Dam (blt) — clothing-colour naming pair (say it once). Latin ad hoc (Tai Viet less used here — note).

languages.name: Cantonese (Yue)
languages.notes: Hoa (ethnic Chinese) ~800k+, Cholon (HCMC Chinatown) Cantonese-dominant. Splits vs Teochew/Hokkien/Hakka SOFT (no-fabrication: only Yue entered). Shared with MY entry. zho member.

languages.name: English
languages.notes: Business/tourism/education English (HCMC/Hanoi/Da Nang) — booming (Samsung-economy effect). No official function.
